name: Jianlong OA Token
description: Exchange a Jianlong OA access token on behalf of the employee who sent the IM message, for calling OA APIs.
configuration.base_url.label: OA auth service URL
configuration.base_url.description: Root URL of the service hosting /oauth2/wecom_agent_token, without the API path
configuration.app_id.label: App ID
configuration.app_id.description: The caller app key registered in the user center
configuration.app_secret.label: App secret
configuration.app_secret.description: The secret paired with the App ID, stored encrypted by POCO
capabilities.title: Capabilities
capabilities.token.title: Exchange OA token
capabilities.token.description: Exchange the sender's IM user ID for an OA access token, returning the employee number and expiry.
limits.title: Scope
limits.description: Works only in IM conversations such as WeCom, DingTalk and Feishu; web conversations carry no employee identity. In group chats the sender of the current message is used. Tokens are valid for 10 minutes by default.
